Name: Luz in Hittite Territory
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the land of the Hittites (Luweizeh, Lebanon, proposed)
Description: The city built by the man who showed Israel the entrance into Bethel, who went into the land of the Hittites and founded a second city called Luz, which kept the name — a northern Luz, distinct from Bethel's former name.
BiblicalSignificance: Judges 1:26 preserves a rare story of a man rewarded with a city of his own; this Luz carries Bethel's old name into exile in the north.
